name: Environmental Threat Monitoring Circuit
short_description: Monitors enclosure, illumination, visual sharpness, and occlusion density to assess environmental threat and modulate avoidance behavior and physiological responses.

components.name: ENCLOSURE_DETECTOR
components.description: Assesses degree of physical enclosure and spatial confinement

components.name: ILLUMINATION_ASSESSOR
components.description: Evaluates ambient light levels and visual clarity

components.name: OCCLUSION_SCANNER
components.description: Detects visual obstructions and hidden hazards in the environment

components.name: THREAT_INTEGRATOR
components.description: Combines enclosure, illumination, and occlusion signals into integrated threat assessment

key_references: Appleton, J. (1975). The Experience of Landscape. John Wiley & Sons.
Grinde, B., & Patil, G. G. (2009). Biophilia: Does visual contact with nature impact on health and well-being? International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health, 6(9), 2332–2343.
design_implications: Environments with high enclosure and low illumination trigger threat responses; balance concealment with sightlines and lighting to optimize safety perception
Occluded areas increase threat perception and avoidance; maintain visual transparency in critical spaces (e.g., public pathways, seating areas)
